name: boof-claw
description: Agent Task Runner — queue prompts and run them through a planner → developer → reviewer pipeline

scripts.desktop:build: npm run build -w @boof-claw/web && npm run build -w @boof-claw/desktop
scripts.desktop: npm run desktop:build && npm run start -w @boof-claw/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run desktop:build && npm run dist -w @boof-claw/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist:mac: npm run desktop:build && npm run dist:mac -w @boof-claw/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist:win: npm run desktop:build && npm run dist:win -w @boof-claw/desktop
